shared_elements: animal shown in profile, low relief
bird or bird-like creature with rendered wing/plumage
horizontal band of small repeated marks (fringe/notches) dividing the field
several creatures crowded/overlapping in one field
raised flat-relief figures against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces show profile animals, including a bird-like creature with indicated plumage, rendered in flat raised relief against a plain ground, and both include a horizontal band of small repeated notches that separates the figural field from an adjacent zone. However, A is organised into clear stacked registers with distinct, widely spaced schematic creatures (canid, small crouching figure, large bird head, net-pattern band), whereas B shows a compact, overlapping, more modelled tangle of a large winged creature above other animal bodies, so the specific motifs and their relationships do not correspond.
